title: lathyrus aureus subsp. occidentalis
intro: Lathyrus aureus subsp. occidentalis, commonly known as the Western golden pea, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family (Fabaceae). This plant is known for its health benefits, particularly its ability to reduce inflammation and improve cardiovascular health due to its high content of flavonoids and polyphenols. The therapeutic actions of Lathyrus aureus subsp. occidentalis include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory effects, which contribute to its potential use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include isoflavones, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
